cases.sql: SELECT z.region_name, SUM(s.pack_units) AS total_pack_units FROM sales AS s JOIN organizations AS o ON s.org_id = o.org_id JOIN zip_territory AS z ON o.zip = z.zip WHERE s.data_source = 'distributor' AND s.brand_flag = 1 AND o.is_340b = 0 GROUP BY z.region_name ORDER BY total_pack_units DESC LIMIT 1000
cases.answer:
